description: Análisis de la situación de trasvase de arenas y propuestas de futuro del puerto de el Masnou is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Study that collects, from a more general perspective, all the information on the problem of sand loss and the disappearance of beaches in the Maresme region. From a more specific level, the study focuses on the port of Masnou and the coastal dynamics correction measures that can be applied there. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Analysis of the sand transfer situation and proposals for the future of the port of Masnou" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
